# Synthetic Homology inputs

All data in this directory are SYNTHETIC, not scientific measurements and not
retained live BV-BRC results. IDs, functions, organisms and task/workspace
receipts in tests are invented. Raw and table fixtures were copied unchanged
from the artifact proposal example directory. The processed arrays and metadata
sidecars there were produced by its extracted retained HomologySearch Perl
transformation methods on those synthetic raw documents. The source harness
was not a BLAST execution. The hand-authored table is not formatter-equivalence
evidence. No archive decoder, live service or biological output is claimed.
